plugins.name: Reddit Communities
plugins.description: Shows Reddit communities from search results with member count, age and description, sorted by member count or relevance. Uses counts from sjclayton's Reddit engine when available, or works standalone when a Reddit cookie is set in its settings.

engines.name: Yandex
engines.description: Yandex web search on yandex.com. No query-level keyword blocks, supports safe-search and optional cookies. Using the Camoufox transport is recommended.

engines.name: Yandex Images
engines.description: Yandex image search. No query-level keyword blocks, supports safe-search with unblurred NSFW results when off, size, type, layout filters and optional cookies.

engines.name: Yandex Visual Search
engines.description: Yandex reverse image search. Upload an image or use the image tab to find pages containing it and similar images, NSFW results are not blocked when safe-search is off. Supports optional cookies

engines.name: Yandex Videos
engines.description: Yandex video search. No query-level keyword blocks, supports safe-search with unblurred NSFW results when off and optional cookies.

engines.name: Reddit
engines.description: Reddit post and community search through Reddit's search JSON. Supports safe-search, sort order, r/subreddit scoping and community member counts. Using the Camoufox transport is recommended.

engines.name: Mojeek
engines.description: Mojeek web search. Solves the ALTCHA challenge automatically, supports safe-search, time filter and optional cookies.
